title: Talk About an Old and a New Habit

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Aim for 90–120 seconds; this is a suggested target, not a minimum. Use at least six lesson words. To pass review, your answer’s transcript must contain at least 100 words, and the required audio and review evidence must be available. The reference and its audio are short language examples, not full-length demonstrations; create your own answer.
prompt: Describe a fictional habit that has changed. Explain what you used to do, what you do now, and what you would record about the change. Aim to speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
reference: I used to have a very rushed morning routine. I often left home without breakfast, and I felt sleepy when I arrived at work. Now I prepare a small snack the evening before and put it beside my bag. I have also started a journal where I write my bedtime and the time I leave home. At lunch I sometimes stretch with a colleague or take a quiet walk. These notes help me notice a pattern, but they do not prove the cause of my mood. I prefer a gradual change that fits my lifestyle, and I can adjust it if my schedule changes. I would ask a professional if I had a health concern.
